kdp_metadata.description:
April 14, 1912. A sysadmin who has spent his whole life managing the unmanageable wakes inside the maiden voyage of the Titanic - knowing exactly how the night ends, and exactly how little that knowledge is worth.

What begins as a dream of period detail becomes a reckoning with everything he has ever failed to break: the institution, the performance of unsinkability, the woman he has never told the truth to. As the ship performs its own certainty and the water rises, knowledge curdles into liability, and the only remaining move is to stop managing and let the structure fall.

A literary time-travel novel about class, catastrophe, and the difference between surviving a night and living through it.
